annotations.title: Import saved videos from a data export

description: Bring the videos the person saved on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube into the style library as links, from the data export they downloaded themselves; nothing is downloaded from the networks. Files: Instagram saved_posts.json and saved_collections.json (Accounts Center > Export your information, JSON); TikTok user_data_tiktok.json or Favorite Videos.txt (Settings > Account > Download your data); a YouTube Takeout playlist CSV such as "Liked videos.csv". Call mode preview first: it shows the lists in the file (saved, collections, favorites, likes, history) and the newest links. Then mode add with the lists or urls the person picked, or newest for the most recent. MCP requests stop at about 100 KB: for a bigger file send just its links, one per line with the date saved, or POST the same JSON to /api/v1/style/references/import (up to 5 MB). Undo removes everything one import added.

content.description: The export file's text: JSON, CSV, HTML or TXT as downloaded, or plain links one per line. Over REST: jq -Rs '{mode:"preview",file_name:"saved_posts.json",content:.}' saved_posts.json | curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- <origin>/api/v1/style/references/import

file_name.description: The file's name in the export (saved_posts.json, Liked videos.csv); it helps name the list.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

lists.description: Lists from preview to take links from. Defaults to the saved lists (saved, collections, favorites), else all.

mode.description: preview reads the file and changes nothing; add saves the selected links.

newest.description: Take only the newest this many of the selected links.

note.description: A note for every link added, in the person's words.

urls.description: Exact links from the file to add instead of whole lists.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: style_references_import
